name: Chups Analytics
description: Product analytics, heatmaps, and session replay for your sites. Paste one snippet per site and see where attention pools and where users fall off — right inside Eesa.

tools.name: traffic_summary
tools.description: Visitors, pageviews, top sources and devices for a site over a time window (e.g. last 7 days).

tools.name: top_pages
tools.description: The most-visited pages for a site over a time window, with visitors and pageviews.

tools.name: funnel_report
tools.description: Conversion rate and per-step drop-off for a named funnel on a site.

roles.label: Analytics Admin
roles.description: Manage tracked sites, copy install snippets, and view all analytics for the workspace.
